events.text: I'll build you a little working engine on your table, so you can poke through each stroke yourself.

steps: Intake: piston drops, fuel and air enter
Power: spark ignites, piston pushed down
Exhaust: piston rises, burnt gases leave
That push turns the crankshaft, making motion

events.text: Your engine is on the table, showing intake, compression, power and exhaust. Poke next to step through each stroke slowly.
It's ready on the table. Poke next, or switch on auto play, to watch the four strokes.

notes: The live agent generated a stroke-stepper engine (Next and Auto buttons poked with the index finger), not a pinch-to-expand one: this is what the model wrote in this take. Building wait from "Building it..." to run_code. Pokes are real fingertip contact read by the generated program.
